permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Fetches FX rates via our Cloudflare Workers proxy (currency-g2-proxy.evde.workers.dev) that caches Frankfurter/ECB data. With a user-provided Groq key, voice audio is sent to api.groq.com. Phone settings also link to groq.com and frankfurter.app for reference.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Used only when you tap Voice and have configured a Groq API key. The recording is sent over HTTPS to api.groq.com for transcription with your own key. Audio is discarded after the request.
